verdicts.reason: Quote verified: moscow-ledger.md:4 does read '> **Owner decision (D-20)**: all 195 Must-haves retained; sequencing deferred to `/plan-phase`.' and grep for 'D-31|v1.5|supersede' over the whole ledger returns zero hits, so the ledger genuinely carries no supersession marker. But the supersession is stated twice, unmissably, in the pipeline key file the ledger is only reachable from: ideation-index.md:206 rewrites the D-20 row itself with strikethrough plus '**— the "defer the beachhead" half is AMENDED by D-31**', and ideation-index.md:296-298 opens the MoSCoW section with '✅ Sequencing RESOLVED by D-31', with :314-316 spelling out 'It no longer needs to pick a beachhead — D-31 did.' The ledger link at ideation-index.md:265 sits inside that same MoSCoW section. Ledger line 3 dates the header block ('Generated from the /ideate-discover breadth pass, 2026-07-16'), framing line 4 as generation-time provenance rather than a live directive. The failure scenario requires a planner to consume the 794-line data table without the index that links to it, which the pipeline's index-first rule forecloses. Stale-copy hygiene, not a live divergence.

The structural observations check out — ideation-cx.md:4 and :56 do route per-pair detail to the source domain's *-cx.md, :57 does claim 184/206, the domain CX files are intra-domain (01's file at identity-profiles-organizations-cx.md:43-361 is CX-01..CX-20, all sub-domain pairs; 04's file has one cross-level section, CX-12 → 09), and §3 (ideation-cx.md:270-424) expands only 01-* and 02-* pairs. But the conclusion 'the IA author must invent' is wrong because the finding measured only the parent CX file. The cross-domain contract lives at leaf level, which is where the fractal structure puts it. For the flagged pair #45 (04↔24): 18 separate domain-04 leaf files carry an explicit 'Touches **24 Trust, Safety & Disputes**' section naming the specific edge (e.g. 04.01.03:200 'enforcement boundary. Description-field circumvention…', 04.03.01:183 'four distinct hand-offs', 04.05.01:229 'permission + abuse. Three edges'), and the exact item in the failure scenario is owned and tracked, not invented: meta/cross-cut-emergent-capabilities.md:152 assigns 'Occupational-requirement-vs-discrimination adjudication' to domain 24 ('Unowned in 04; belongs to 24'), and 04.02.01:278 registers it as Q-04, Owner=User, Deferred To=`/create-prd-security`. Same for pair #52 (05↔21): the payola edge is authored from the 21 side — 21.02.02:81 DT-03 ('the same offer will appear as a service listing in domain 05'), 21.02.02:85 and 21.05.03:126 both carry 'Touches **05 Services Marketplace** — the back door'. The Detail column pointing at the parent CX file is navigational imprecision; the synthesis is not absent.

The individually named items are owned or tracked elsewhere: Promoted Placement is 21.05-paid-promotion (a real sub-domain with 21.05.03 Payola Guardrail); Referrals is tracked at meta/cross-cut-emergent-capabilities.md:150 with owner 03; Offline at the same file :120 ('Offline-First Admit & Reconcile Replica'); Follow/Save/Watchlist exist as owned features (moscow-ledger.md:40 03.01.01 Follows, :449 20.06.01 Artist Tracking & Follow, :688 22.07.01 Artist Watchlists). No competent reader provisions RBAC principals from a recovery-evidence audience list.
